problem_value.label: Problem value
problem_value.retrieval_focus: user need impact and evidence that the problem matters

real_world_pain_point.label: Real-world pain point
real_world_pain_point.retrieval_focus: documented recurring difficulty for identifiable users current workarounds and their cost rather than a hypothetical problem

evidence_quality.label: Evidence quality
evidence_quality.retrieval_focus: quality and limitations of relevant evidence

novelty.label: Novelty and differentiation
novelty.retrieval_focus: prior work comparable projects and open gaps

feasibility.label: Feasibility
feasibility.retrieval_focus: implementation scope time and resource requirements

data_tool_availability.label: Data and tool availability
data_tool_availability.retrieval_focus: accessible datasets tools APIs hardware and licenses

technical_depth.label: Technical depth
technical_depth.retrieval_focus: technical methods engineering challenges and alternatives

evaluation_clarity.label: Evaluation clarity
evaluation_clarity.retrieval_focus: benchmarks objective metrics and evaluation methods

delivery_risk.label: Delivery risk
delivery_risk.retrieval_focus: known limitations dependencies and delivery risks

hard_gates.user_constraints: Does not violate a mandatory user constraint or exclusion.
hard_gates.data_access: Uses available and permitted data and resources.
hard_gates.evidence_sufficiency: Available evidence supports the essential dependencies of the proposed MVP: relevant data, usable tools or methods, and required resources. Identify specific missing support if failing. Expected benefits and performance improvements may remain explicitly unproven hypotheses to test; missing proof of those outcomes alone does not fail this gate. A failed gate blocks automatic recommendation but permits user review only if all other gates pass.
hard_gates.time_scope: No supported, unavoidable dependency of the proposed MVP conflicts with the user's deadline. Fail only for a known conflict, identifying the dependency and supporting evidence or explicit request constraint. Uncertain effort estimates, debugging risk, and unproven benefits are caveats, not proof of a deadline conflict. Passing is not a guarantee of completion.
